_doc: Mona L05 interior landmarks read from XPENG's Cabin 360 panoramas (xpeng.guru, light-grey trim; front = camera at the driver's head, back = camera at the rear-seat centre). yaw/pitch in degrees, yaw 0 = forward, yaw > 0 = right, pitch up (scripts/photo-tools/pano.cjs). model = the landmark in OUR cabin (x forward, y left, z up) where our model has it; omitted when only the photo is read. See scripts/photo-tools/pano_solve.cjs. Our screen leans back by 12 deg (top further FORWARD): glass top x 0.5692, bottom x 0.5245. 2026-11-18 (Phase 2): the screen and wheel now stand FRONT_DX = 0.17 further forward in mona_interior.py, and the wheel is at y 0.366, so their model coordinates here moved with them.
